verdict.rationale: A live probe shows a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://docs.apify.com/api/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The documented REST API v2 pages, such as the webhooks reference, show the spec belongs to a real, documented API surface. Missing for 10: first-party docs that describe or advertise the spec download (versioning, coverage of all endpoints), and independent or community corroboration of using the spec.
